Cancel
Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter: For the easiest first YETI purchase, I’d start with drinkware: - A water bottle is simple for everyday hydration and easy to take anywhere. - A tumbler is a versatile choice for keeping one drink at the right temperature. - A travel mug is a good option if you mainly drink coffee or tea on the go. If you specifically want a cooler, a Roadie® 24 Hard Cooler is an approachable option because it fits behind a front seat and is easy to open with one hand.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
by
Cancel
Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter: For your first use: 1. Fill the bottle with a cold drink. 2. Secure the Yonder™ Cap. It is 100% leakproof. 3. Avoid hot or carbonated beverages, and don’t use it to store food or perishables. 4. When you’re finished, wash the bottle and cap. They’re dishwasher-safe; place the cap on the top rack and the gasket in the utensils basket. The bottle is non-insulated, so condensation can occur and your drink won’t stay hot or cold for an extended period.
